derivation_policy.generation: first-party imports of `roots` under scripts/ (whole AST, lazy imports included, package __init__.py included, a package winning over a same-named module file as in CPython), followed only along chains of allowlisted modules: a module is bounded when a root reaches it through allowlisted modules alone, and a module reached only through an unprotected module is not; regenerated at the candidate's merge base on every evaluation, protected as the union with `members`, and refused as DERIVATION_POLICY_DRIFT only when a committed member is no longer in it (growth is protected, not drift), and regenerated at the candidate head so that a newly added, newly imported allowlisted helper on such a chain is protected in the same change; a module that enters the set at the head unchanged is an `entered` entry. Manifest entries carry SHA-256 image digests and a protected-diff digest, never git object ids; `fingerprint` must be the SHA-256 fingerprint of `public_key`
